latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of docx-processor-cn skill.

- Enables creation, reading, editing, and manipulation of Word (.docx) documents.
- Supports professional document formatting including tables of contents, headings, letterheads, and page numbers.
- Allows extraction, reorganization, and modification of document content, including tracked changes and images.
- Provides technical guidance and best practices for .docx generation/editing using JavaScript (docx-js) and command-line tools.
- Not applicable for PDFs, spreadsheets, or Google Docs; strictly for .docx document workflows.
